name: Hensara III
description: Hensara III, also known simply as Hensara, was a planet in the Colonies. The New Republic's stolen Imperial Customs Frigate Battle of Yavin was sunk in a deep lake on this planet to hide it from an Imperial patrol. The Eridain and Rogue Squadron retrieved the ship's crew and defeated the Empire in the Rout of Hensara.
